attributes.residual: CLOSED, real 0, EXACT. THE CAP'S DIAGNOSIS WAS ENTIRELY CORRECT AND IS REPRODUCED FROM THE BYTES: 78/78, opcode multiset identical, residual = (1) `addi r28,r4,0` emitted at +0x30 in ours before `stw r0,232(r31)` and after it in retail, and (2) the coupled fifteen-word recolor of the gPlayers address web. Only the ELIGIBILITY conclusion was wrong, and instrumenting the refusal per discipline 14 shows it was a fact about the checker: webfrank_audit screens for PURE recolors and by construction cannot see a function that needs a permutation first, so its silence carried no information about this function. The two atoms are independent -- `addi r28,r4,0` writes g28 and reads g4, `stw r0,232(r31)` reads g0 and g31 and writes memory -- with no relocation and no control instruction in the window, and check_permutation_dependences accepts at exit_dead=None. With the schedule aligned the fifteen remaining words are a position-consistent renaming machine-proven by verify_consistent_recolor with no audit escape. THE GENERAL LESSON, which is why this record supersedes rather than merely follows the cap: the cap held one variable fixed (it asked whether a RECOLOR alone could close the function) and correctly answered no; the joint probe -- permutation AND recolor together -- was never run, which is AGENTS.md residual-work discipline 6 exactly.
